# ⚔️ Competitive Vanilla+ (PvP) ModPack

![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc6cf5e13f61f6c2065e8c51747cc8674aa3d54c_0.webp)

**Competitive Vanilla+ (PvP)** is a lightweight Minecraft modpack designed to improve your PvP and gameplay experience while staying close to the vanilla feel.

It focuses on performance, clarity, and competitive quality-of-life improvements — without turning Minecraft into something unrecognizable.

---

## ✨ Features

⚡ **Optimized Performance**  
Smooth gameplay with performance mods for higher FPS and reduced stutters.

🎒 **Inventory & Utility Improvements**  
Better inventory management, item visibility, and overall QoL features to speed up gameplay decisions.

🎯 **PvP-Focused Enhancements**  
Small but powerful improvements that help in competitive situations without giving unfair advantages.

🎨 **Clean Vanilla+ Experience**  
Keeps the original Minecraft feel while making everything more responsive and readable.

---

## 🔗 Community

Join the Discord for updates, support, and suggestions:

[![Join DC [middle small]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfca91ef533789255f946e0c21aa5a6f4925876f_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/mP23dpVQ6V)

---

## 🔥 Perfect for:

- PvP servers  
- Practice & competitive gameplay  
- Vanilla+ survival with friends  
- Players who want a cleaner, faster Minecraft experience  

---

## 📦 Philosophy

This modpack is built around one idea:

> Improve gameplay without changing what makes Minecraft feel like Minecraft.

No unnecessary clutter. No overhauls. Just a sharper, smoother experience.

---

## 🧩 Updates

This modpack will continue to receive updates with:
- performance improvements  
- QoL additions  
- community suggestions  
- balance adjustments  

---

## 🤝 Credits

Credits appreciated but not required.
